Request execution and response lifetimes
|-- Middleware gate precedes namespace dispatch
|   |-- Outside /api and /internal segments -> next()
|   |-- Disabled HTTP + classified agent mutation + falsy binding header -> 403
|   |-- /internal passes the prefix filter, then fails /api/ namespace validation
|   `-- Only known /api/ namespaces reach the route invocation try/catch
|-- POST core/project/definitions
|   |-- ensureDefinitionsEnabled() -> read body -> create AbortController
|   |-- response.once('close'): abort if response has not ended
|   |-- await source.definitions(body, signal)
|   `-- Send result only if not destroyed; finally remove close listener
|-- POST mapping/prompt
|   |-- read body -> await selection.prepare(input)
|   |-- Set 200, NDJSON, no-cache/no-transform; flush headers
|   |-- await selection.run(prepared, event callback) -> progress events
|   `-- Send result event -> response.end()
|-- Errors caught around route invocation
|   |-- Headers sent -> error event; end unless destroyed or already ended
|   `-- Headers unsent -> JSON status
|       |-- RequestTooLarge: 413; ProjectDiagramConflict: 409
|       |-- ApplicationError: conflict 409; invalid-input 400; binary-source 415
|       |-- lsp-disabled / ai-disabled / storage-unavailable: 503
|       |   `-- Only first two also add LSP_DISABLED / AI_DISABLED code
|       `-- Other errors: 400
|-- Mapping route details
|   |-- evals requires evalRuns AND evalPrompts AND evalReferences
|   |-- Workspace PUT and records/export/import-contexts POST: 64 MiB body limit
|   |-- records GET: history=current selects current; otherwise all
|   `-- /diagrams/publish: POST publishes; DELETE matches generic id "publish"
`-- Core catalog details
    |-- corpus-compactions requires project before method dispatch
    `-- representations: history=current selects current; otherwise all
